fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is blocked by A, E, H, I, and J. Digit normalization does not exclude an exact cross-level signed carry kernel, gate deletion costs only O(t), and no proof converts coefficient divisibility into a polynomial relative CVP gap after accounting for the honest baseline and circuit size.

Proposal 2 remains blocked by H, I, and J. Multiplication tables emitted linearly admit signed nongroup-like combinations, and testing whether the known two-negative G19 flow leaves one Heisenberg residual neither exhausts unrestricted fibers nor establishes growth for increasing nilpotency class.

Proposal 3 is blocked by F and K. Any linear lookup lift of all honest encodings preserves the coefficient-sum-one G13 affine combination, while catalecticant constraints require another vulnerable linearized table layer; the diagonal/secant shortcut is explicitly unresolved.

Proposal 4 is blocked by I and K. Degrees 3–5 on the special nine-clause obstruction cannot discriminate whether general 3SAT has polynomial Macaulay degree, dimension, and certificate height, and no fixed dual CVP embedding establishes the required completeness/soundness direction.

Proposal 5 is blocked by F, I, J, and K. A linear code subspace or affine coset containing every honest encoding also contains their coefficient-sum-one G13 combination, and concatenation still admits tensor-diagonal or entangled shortcuts without a proved finite-state recurrence.

Proposal 7 is analytically killed by F. If every honest global encoding has the same tag target, the verified coefficient-sum-one G13 affine combination has that target under every linear integer tag, regardless of B_h dissociation; the proposed cancellation equations therefore force the forbidden short relation.

Proposal 6 has no asymptotic result: naming attack classes does not itself prove exhaustive state closure, and a depth-two pass cannot be promoted beyond that frozen recursion rule. It is nevertheless the sole proposal with a potentially complete bounded falsifier if the tile, target, ports, glue, control, coefficient bound, and class partition are serialized before enumeration.
evidence: G13 verifies an integral coefficient-sum-one affine collision, and G15 carries it through every tested hierarchy node with zero residual below threshold. This directly defeats linear compatible tags, lookup lifts, and protected affine subspaces.

G19 verifies a zero-residual accepting flow with two negative coefficients. Any gate-table, path-product, or transfer mechanism must search all signed fibers rather than only honest or seeded extensions.
G7, G9, and G11 exhibit exact or constant-cost signed/parity kernels, while G12 shows that charging parity can expose a cheaper clause drop. Residual detection alone has not produced relative growth.
G14 proves only a finite shell pass through B+32 for one pair-bag instance. No verifier establishes composition, finite-state closure, λ>μ, or polynomial relative-gap growth.

No proposal supplies new experimental evidence. Proposal 6 alone directly implements the reopening experiment demanded by the previous gate; all other proposed tests leave their decisive blocker untouched.
